name: QuickBooks
one_liner: Intuit QuickBooks Online accounting product with OAuth 2.0 REST API.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 with client id/secret; app registered on Intuit Developer Portal; refresh tokens rotate with 100-day window.
access_notes: Free Builder partner tier ($0, 500,000 CorePlus credits/month, blocked after); Silver $300, Gold $1,700, Platinum $4,500; premium APIs need Silver+ and a support ticket. Go-live app review not verified from fetched pages.

buildability.rationale: Free sandbox and Builder tier; production needs public HTTPS redirect, 100-day refresh window and metered CorePlus reads beyond 500k.

needs_human_reason: developer.intuit.com is a JS shell; go-live review, webhooks and rate limits not verified; pricing from third party (apideck).

auth.quote: You must register an app on the Intuit Developer Portal and complete a one-time, browser-based OAuth handshake.

access.quote: Overage: API calls are blocked after exceeding the 500,000 limit

sandbox.quote: Sandbox supports http://localhost redirect URIs; production requires a public HTTPS callback for the initial authorization.

api_surface.quote: 145 Total Tools - Complete coverage of QuickBooks Online API

mcp.quote: this is a local MCP server. It runs as a stdio subprocess on the developer's or partner's machine

identity.quote: only applies to QuickBooks Online (QBO) integrations

disputes.why: Free Builder tier at $0 with 500k CorePlus credits; premium APIs gated to paid tiers.
Official MCP README documents sandbox environment and localhost redirects.
intuit GitHub org publishes quickbooks-online-mcp-server (local stdio).
145 is the MCP tool count, not a REST endpoint count; treat as tool estimate.
